warnings.text:
XAiPromptFailureText extends Error, but a VibeLang failure is an error declaration.
  No quick fix: an error declaration's constructor takes one object of its fields, so declaring XAiPromptFailureText with error would change the constructor it exports, new XAiPromptFailureText(message, options).

trustedPackages is deprecated and ignored; remove this retired option. Use a signature contract or an explicit Effect.try boundary for foreign calls.
